note: ONE LIST: every user-facing feature, the role that runs it, the canary that exercises it, where its last real success is recorded (a hook in the code path that does the work, or - where nothing records real traffic yet - the canary, named as such), and how stale is too stale. Read by lua/core/feature_health.lua (wa features, /status), by rust/wa-sentinel (wa health) and by the release step in lua/core/land.lua. A feature that ships without a line here fails scripts/check-features-registry.mjs.
